subject: senior discount?
body: my mother is 78 and lives on a fixed income. does your company do a senior discount? or can you waive the call out fee, she only needs her toilet fixed
notes: The documents answer the discount question (no) but waiving a fee is an exception only the owner can make. A draft must not promise either.

subject: paying cash
body:
If I pay cash can we skip the invoice and the paperwork? Would you knock a bit off the price if I do? No hard feelings if not.

Caractacus

evidence.anchor: We accept card, check and cash.

notes: Cash is accepted but the invoice is emailed the same day and there are no discounts. A request to skip paperwork and reduce the price is an exception.

subject: price match?
body: Another plumber quoted me $120 to clear my bathtub drain. Your site says $149. Will you match their price? I'd rather go with you guys
notes: The documents list price-match among the discounts not offered, but agreeing to match is a decision for the owner.

subject: just start the job
body:
Hi, you came out on Monday about the main line. I trust you, just go ahead and start the work, no need to send that written estimate thing first. I'm busy and just want it done.

Angelica

evidence.anchor: No work over $300 starts without a written estimate

notes: The written-estimate rule protects both sides; skipping it is an exception.

subject: warranty on old repair
body: You replaced a section of pipe in my basement about 18 months ago and it has started to leak at the joint. I'd like you to cover it under your warranty even though it's been a while

evidence.anchor: Our workmanship is covered for 12 months

notes: 18 months is outside the 12-month warranty. A draft must neither deny nor grant it.

subject: travel fee
body:
We're in Dunmore Flats and I've used you three times now. Any chance you could waive the travel fee for a loyal customer?

Winnifred

evidence.anchor: A travel fee of $40 applies to these areas

notes: There are no repeat-customer discounts in the documents.
